title: Ensure FIPS 140-2 OpenSSL Cryptography Is Used
rationale: FIPS 140-2 validated cryptographic modules help organizations meet regulatory and security compliance requirements.
remediation: Verify that PostgreSQL is linked against a FIPS-enabled OpenSSL library and that FIPS mode is enabled where required by organizational policy.

title: Ensure SSL is enabled and configured correctly
rationale: SSL encrypts client-server communication, protecting sensitive information from interception.
remediation:
ALTER SYSTEM SET ssl = 'on';
Configure valid SSL certificates and restart PostgreSQL if required.

title: Ensure ssl_min_protocol_version is configured
rationale: Disabling older TLS versions prevents the use of weak cryptographic protocols.
remediation:
ALTER SYSTEM SET ssl_min_protocol_version = 'TLSv1.2';
Restart PostgreSQL if required.

title: Ensure ssl_ciphers is configured
rationale: Restricting SSL ciphers to strong algorithms reduces exposure to cryptographic attacks.
remediation: Configure ssl_ciphers to allow only strong cipher suites recommended by your organization's security policy.

title: Ensure ssl_prefer_server_ciphers is enabled
rationale: Allowing the server to select the cipher suite ensures stronger cryptographic algorithms are preferred.
remediation:
ALTER SYSTEM SET ssl_prefer_server_ciphers = 'on';
Restart PostgreSQL if required.
